title: Clarity of Scripture
definition: The clarity of Scripture means that the essential message of the Bible can be understood by ordinary believers who read it with humility, prayer, and dependence on God.
summary: Not every passage is equally easy, and faithful teachers are a gift to the church. Yet God has spoken clearly enough for His people to know the Gospel, understand His commands, and walk in faithful obedience.
christFocus: The Scriptures clearly reveal Christ as Savior and Lord. The central message of redemption is not hidden from ordinary people; God makes Christ known through His Word.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Bible is not a locked book for spiritual elites only. God speaks to His people in a way that can be understood, even though some passages require careful study, context, and teaching.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: The clarity of Scripture encourages believers to read the Bible for themselves while still valuing the church, teachers, and wise counsel. It protects against spiritual manipulation and dependency on human authorities.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Read Scripture patiently and prayerfully. Use context, compare Scripture with Scripture, ask for help when needed, and trust that God can teach ordinary believers through His Word.
